question: Should ClawHub adopt `claw` as an experimental durable package family and manifest/storage contract for the RFC #27 staged rollout before any publication or discovery surfaces are merged?
rationale: This branch changes a shared schema and persisted release shape; code review cannot determine whether the repository should make that long-lived product and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Defer pending RFC sponsorship
options.body: Keep the draft stack open but do not merge this base contract until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the RFC-aligned experimental package-family direction.

options.title: Sponsor the staged contract
options.body: Approve the contract as an experimental, gated foundation and require refreshed compatibility review plus inspectable proof before merging the slices in order.

options.title: Narrow the experiment first
options.body: Request a smaller private/internal schema boundary that avoids broadening shared package-family contracts until the publication and discovery design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Defer pending RFC sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the draft stack open but do not merge this base contract until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the RFC-aligned experimental package-family direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed owner of the coordinated proposal and can clarify the contract; repository maintainers retain the approval decision.
